Senior Product Manager, Risk

As a Senior Product Manager on the Risk team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll own the product strategy and roadmap for how Coinbase detects, prevents, and responds to fraud, account takeover, and scam risk across our platform. This team builds the products and risk controls that protect millions of customers and billions in assets. You'll partner with Engineering, Data Science, and Risk Analytics to ship products that stay ahead of evolving threats while keeping the customer experience fast and frictionless.

What you'll do:

• Own the product roadmap for one or more risk domains (e.g., ATO prevention, scam detection, payment fraud), defining the vision, priorities, and success metrics that reduce customer losses and improve detection accuracy

• Partner with Risk Analytics and ML teams to translate fraud signals, model outputs, and emerging threat patterns into product requirements and control strategies

• Lead experimentation and measurement of risk interventions, using data to quantify impact on fraud rates, false positive rates, and customer friction

• Shape the long-term risk product strategy by analyzing industry trends, regulatory shifts, and crypto-specific threat vectors to keep Coinbase ahead of adversaries

Required Skills and Experience:

• 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on risk, fraud, trust and safety, or payments in a consumer fintech or e-commerce environment

• Proven track record shipping risk or fraud products that measurably reduced loss rates, improved detection precision, or scaled risk controls across multiple product surfaces

• Deep fluency in data-driven decision-making, including defining metrics, running experiments, and interpreting ML model performance to inform product direction

• Experience partnering with engineering and data science teams to build and iterate on real-time risk systems, rules engines, or ML-powered detection pipelines

• Demonstrated ability to communicate complex risk trade-offs to senior leadership, translating technical fraud concepts into clear business impact narratives

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Join the Pioneer Crypto Brand in the Philippines!

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

What You Will Do
As Compliance Officer

• Build, then keep current, each entity's written compliance program: client and beneficial-ownership due diligence, enhanced measures for higher-risk clients, record keeping, travel-rule data, and training.

• Assess money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions-evasion risk across clients, products, channels, and geographies, and assess new products, payment rails, and corridors before launch.

• Set the outside compliance provider's scope, review its work, and sign off what it produces.

• Run the ongoing staff training program, and keep each entity's registrations current with FINTRAC, the Bank of Canada, and FinCEN.

• Lead regulator examinations and information requests, and answer due-diligence requests from banks, payout partners, and clients.

• Monitor US state money transmission licensing requirements and advise the business before it enters a new state or product.

As MLRO

• Run transaction monitoring and sanctions screening, and decide every escalated alert.

• Canada: file suspicious transaction and terrorist property reports with FINTRAC, and oversee the other prescribed reports.

• US: file suspicious activity reports with FinCEN, and oversee currency transaction reporting and OFAC blocking and reject reporting.

• Act as the contact for law enforcement requests and production orders, and protect the confidentiality of every report.

As Risk Officer

• Canada: act as the senior officer overseeing the risk management and incident response framework under the Retail Payment Activities Act, including incident reports, third-party risk, and any safeguarding-of-funds framework.

• Canada: file the annual report to the Bank of Canada by March 31, and give notice of significant changes or new activity ahead of time.

• Maintain each entity's risk register and risk appetite across compliance, operational, third-party, and partner risk, and report to the board.

• Commission the independent reviews required under each regime, and track every finding to closure.

What we expect from you
Must have

• At least 7 years in anti-money-laundering and sanctions compliance at money services businesses, payment companies, or the payments arm of a bank, including 3 or more as a compliance officer, MLRO, or deputy.

• Deep knowledge of Canada's Proceeds of Crime (Money Laundering) and Terrorist Financing Act and FINTRAC's guidance, and working knowledge of the Retail Payment Activities Act.

• Experience building a compliance program, not only running one: policies, risk assessment, and training plan.

• Experience deciding on and filing suspicious transaction reports, and running transaction monitoring and sanctions screening.

• Experience taking a business through a FINTRAC, bank-partner, or audit examination and closing the findings.

• Due diligence experience on business clients, including clients that pay out for their own customers, and on banks and payout partners.

• A recognised AML certification, such as CAMS, or equivalent experience.

• Clear writing for boards, regulators, and banks, and the ability to work alone across time zones.

• Able to pass the background checks that regulators and banking partners require.

Join the Coins Team Now!

Meaningful Collaborations - The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with other relevant teams to carry out implementations that will improve and create an impact on customer experience.

Scalable Growth - Be part of a fast-growing organization with the vision to expand its territories outside APAC which will provide opportunities for career advancement.

A Space For Bright Ideas - Let your bright ideas be converted into meaningful changes! Coins culture welcomes new ideas backed up by data to create an impact.

We are looking for a Wallet Leader to own wallet operations across our global business. You will be based in Hong Kong and run day-to-day wallet operations for every region we operate in. You will make sure funds move safely, accurately and on time, and you will lead the wallet operations team. You'll work closely with Security, Compliance, Engineering, Finance and Customer Operations.


Key Responsibilities
• Own global wallet operations end to end, covering hot, warm and cold wallets.

• Manage daily fund movements: customer withdrawals, hot wallet top-ups, cold storage transfers, rebalancing and sweeping across chains and entities.

• Operate our Fireblocks environment day to day, including vault management, user roles and permissions, transaction authorization policies, approval workflows, whitelisting and API integrations.

• Monitor wallet balances, on-chain activity and pending transactions, and resolve stuck, failed or delayed transactions quickly.

• Run regular wallet reconciliations and proof-of-reserves processes with Finance and Audit.

• Manage new chain and token onboarding from the operations side, working with Engineering and Security.

• Handle wallet incidents and escalations, and lead post-incident reviews.

• Keep wallet operations in line with Compliance and Security requirements, and support auditor and regulator requests when needed.

• Lead, coach and build the wallet operations team, including colleagues in other locations, with clear coverage across time zones.

• 7+ years in crypto, fintech or financial infrastructure, with 3+ years running wallet operations at a licensed VASP or exchange (e.g. OSL, HashKey, or similar).

• Strong hands-on experience with Fireblocks in a production environment, including vault management, transaction policies, approval and signing workflows, and API or webhook integrations.

• Experience running wallet operations across multiple entities or jurisdictions, or equivalent scale.

• Solid understanding of major blockchains (BTC, ETH, EVM chains, Tron, etc.) and on-chain transaction monitoring.

• Working knowledge of key management, multi-sig and MPC concepts.

• Proven experience building controls, SOPs and audit-ready documentation.

• Experience leading an operations team across locations.

• Strong communication in English. Cantonese or Mandarin is a plus.

• Based in Hong Kong or willing to relocate.

Nice to Have
• Experience with other custody or MPC platforms alongside Fireblocks (e.g. Copper, BitGo, Cobo).

• Experience with exchange and OTC wallet operations at scale.

• Experience passing external audits and regulatory inspections.

• Experience working across time zones with teams in Asia and other regions.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Model Risk Director focused on Fraud and AI to join OKX’s Model Risk Management (MRM) function. As a senior member of the second line of defense (2LOD), this leader will provide independent oversight and effective challenge of fraud models used to detect, prevent, and manage fraud risk across OKX’s products and customer journeys.

The role will lead end-to-end validation of fraud models, from conceptual soundness, data and implementation review to outcomes analysis, performance monitoring, and remediation follow-up. The portfolio may include supervised machine learning models, anomaly detection, graph and network analytics, rules-based or hybrid systems, and AI-enabled fraud applications.

The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on experience in fraud model validation, strong quantitative judgment, and practical experience assessing AI/ML models. This person will partner closely with Fraud, Risk, Product, Data Science, Engineering, Compliance, and Audit teams while maintaining the independence of the MRM function.

This is a hands-on, builder role: the successful candidate will independently establish the fraud model validation capability from the ground up, personally execute validations, and play a leading role in assessing AI-enabled systems.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Establish and own the independent validation framework for fraud models and AI-enabled decision systems across OKX products, covering conceptual soundness, data quality, implementation, and outcomes analysis, in line with SR 26-2 and equivalent model risk frameworks.

•

Assess model conceptual soundness, intended use, assumptions, and limitations.

•

Personally execute end-to-end model validations as the technical expert, including independently reproducing results through hands-on data analysis and code review.

•

Assess AI/ML and generative AI applications, including LLM-based and agentic systems, for robustness, reliability, explainability, and appropriate human oversight, applying strong applied AI evaluation expertise.

•

Perform ongoing monitoring review and periodic revalidation to ensure sustained model performance through changing fraud patterns and business conditions.

•

Provide effective challenge to model owners; communicate conclusions, limitations, and risk ratings clearly to senior management and governance forums, and track remediation through closure.

•

Build and continuously mature the fraud model validation capability, standards, and workflows within MRM.

What We Look For In You

•

Master’s or Ph.D. in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

•

10+ years of quantitative, fraud risk, or model risk experience, with a recognized track record as a hands-on technical expert who personally delivers independent validations of models and decision systems.

•

Excellent communication and judgment, including the ability to explain quantitative findings to senior audiences and constructively challenge model owners.

•

Practical experience with statistical and machine learning methods; proficiency in Python and SQL; working knowledge of SR 11-7 or equivalent model risk and AI governance frameworks.

•

Experience with AI/ML governance and controls, including explainability, fairness, robustness, ongoing monitoring, or generative and agentic AI applications in fraud operations.

Nice to Haves

•

Experience establishing validation frameworks, methodologies, or capabilities in settings where they did not previously exist.

•

Strong applied AI capability: hands-on experience evaluating or building ML/LLM-based systems in production, including prompt engineering, evaluation harnesses, fine-tuning assessment, or agentic AI workflows; able to run red-team style testing on AI applications.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

OKX Statement:

OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

•

The salary range for this position is $200,000 - $300,000

•

The salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. In addition to the salary, a performance bonus and long-term incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, as well as a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Applicants should apply via OKX internal or external careers site.

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

About the Role

CMC Markets is seeking an experienced, commercially minded and highly capable Director of Corporate and Commercial Law to join its EMEA Legal team in London.

The successful candidate will take a leading role in providing strategic and practical legal advice across the Group's corporate and commercial activities, with particular emphasis on mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, intellectual property, commercial contracts, data protection, and other strategic business initiatives.

The role requires a senior lawyer with broad technical expertise, excellent drafting and negotiation skills, strong commercial judgement and proven experience managing and developing other lawyers.

The successful candidate will be comfortable acting as a subject-matter expert on complex legal matters, advising senior management and working collaboratively with colleagues across the business. They will also be expected to demonstrate flexibility, taking responsibility for legal matters outside their principal areas of expertise as business requirements evolve.

This is a senior position within the EMEA Legal function, combining significant legal advisory responsibilities with leadership and management of a team of senior and junior lawyers.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Law and Strategic Transactions

• Lead the provision of legal advice on corporate transactions, including mergers and acquisitions, disposals, joint ventures, strategic investments, corporate reorganisations, and other significant corporate initiatives.

• Draft, review and negotiate complex corporate transaction documents, including share purchase agreements, shareholders' agreements, joint venture agreements, and related contractual arrangements.

• Advise on corporate governance matters, corporate structures and the legal implications of strategic business decisions.

• Support transaction structuring, due diligence, negotiation, execution and post-completion implementation.

• Work closely with senior management, Finance, Strategy and other business functions on corporate projects and strategic initiatives.

• Identify and manage legal and commercial risks arising from corporate transactions and business structures.

Commercial Law and Contracts

• Lead the drafting, review and negotiation of complex and commercially significant contracts across the business.

• Advise on commercial arrangements, including strategic partnerships, outsourcing, technology, licensing, procurement, distribution and services agreements.

• Provide practical advice on contractual risk allocation, liability, indemnities, warranties, termination rights and dispute resolution provisions.

• Develop and maintain contractual standards, precedents and negotiation positions to support consistent and efficient legal risk management.

• Support business stakeholders in structuring and negotiating commercial arrangements that achieve business objectives while appropriately protecting CMC Markets' interests.

Intellectual Property

• Oversee legal matters relating to the Group's intellectual property, with particular emphasis on trademarks, brand protection and trademark portfolio management.

• Advise on trademark registration, protection, enforcement, licensing and related intellectual property matters across relevant jurisdictions.

• Work with external intellectual property advisers to manage trademark applications, oppositions, disputes and enforcement activity.

• Support the protection and commercial exploitation of the Group's intellectual property rights, including those relating to technology, software, brands and proprietary business assets.

• Advise on intellectual property ownership, licensing and protection in commercial contracts, corporate transactions and strategic partnerships.

Financial Services Regulation

• Advise on corporate and commercial matters arising in a regulated financial services environment, taking account of applicable UK financial services legislation and regulatory requirements.

• Work closely with Compliance, Risk, Information Security and other specialist functions to address legal issues arising from new products, services and business initiatives.

• Support the assessment of legal risks associated with emerging technologies, digital assets and developing financial markets business models.

Data Protection

• Provide legal advice on data protection and privacy matters, including the contractual and commercial implications of UK GDPR, EU GDPR and related legislation. Support the Data Privacy Officer in the interpretation of data protection legislation and rules.

• Support the negotiation of data processing agreements, data sharing arrangements, and other contracts involving personal data.

Legal Team Leadership and Management

• Manage, supervise and develop a team comprising senior and junior lawyers, ensuring the effective allocation and delivery of legal work.

• Provide technical guidance, oversight and quality assurance on complex legal matters handled by team members.

• Set clear objectives, manage performance and support the professional development and career progression of lawyers within the team.

• Promote a collaborative, accountable and high-performing team culture.

• Oversee workload allocation, prioritisation and resource management to ensure that legal support is delivered effectively and within business deadlines.

• Support the Head of Legal, EMEA in developing and implementing the Legal function's strategy, priorities and operating practices.

• Identify opportunities to improve legal processes, contract management, knowledge sharing and operational efficiency.

• Manage relationships with external legal advisers, including oversight of instructions, quality, budgets and legal expenditure.

General Legal Advisory and Stakeholder Management

• Act as a senior legal adviser and trusted business partner to management and stakeholders across the Group.

• Provide clear, practical and commercially focused advice on complex legal issues, balancing legal requirements, risk exposure and business objectives.

• Lead and coordinate legal support for significant cross-functional and cross-border projects.

• Work collaboratively with other members of the Legal team and specialist functions across the Group.

• Support other areas of legal work as business requirements evolve, demonstrating flexibility and a willingness to take responsibility beyond core areas of expertise.

• Communicate complex legal issues and recommendations clearly and effectively to senior executives, business stakeholders and external counterparties.

• Escalate material legal risks appropriately and contribute to effective legal risk management across the business.

Qualifications and Experience

Essential Requirements

• A law degree or equivalent education and relevant professional experience.

• Professional qualification as a solicitor in England and Wales, or an equivalent qualification in another common law jurisdiction.

• At least 10-15+ years of relevant legal experience, preferably gained at a leading law firm, a financial institution or a well-regarded in-house legal department.

• Strong working knowledge of corporate law, particularly mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, corporate transactions and associated documentation.

• Strong working knowledge of commercial law and substantial experience drafting, negotiating and advising on complex commercial contracts.

• Good working knowledge of intellectual property law, with particular emphasis on trademark protection, management and enforcement.

• Good working knowledge of UK data protection law and its application to commercial arrangements.

• A sound understanding of UK financial services law and regulation, including the legal and commercial considerations relevant to regulated financial services businesses.

• Excellent legal drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to produce clear, precise and commercially effective documentation.

• Proven experience managing, supervising and developing lawyers, including individuals with different levels of seniority and experience.

• Demonstrable ability to lead complex legal matters, exercise independent judgement and provide authoritative advice to senior stakeholders.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify material legal risks and recommend practical solutions.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex legal matters clearly and persuasively to non-legal audiences.

• Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, delegate effectively and deliver results within demanding deadlines.

• Ability to operate independently as a senior subject-matter expert while contributing effectively to a collaborative legal team.

• A flexible, adaptable and proactive approach, including a willingness to advise on legal matters outside core areas of expertise where business needs require.

Desirable Experience

• Experience leading significant mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures or other strategic corporate transactions, whether in private practice or in-house.

• Experience working within an international financial services group, investment firm, brokerage or other FCA-regulated business.

• Experience managing international trademark portfolios and coordinating brand protection activities across multiple jurisdictions.

• Experience advising on technology contracts, software licensing, intellectual property, and complex outsourcing arrangements.

• Knowledge of digital assets, including cryptoassets, tokenised securities, digital asset custody and the legal and regulatory considerations associated with emerging digital asset business models.

• Experience supporting international business operations and coordinating legal advice across multiple jurisdictions.

• Experience implementing legal operations improvements, including contract management systems, legal technology and standardised legal processes.

Your Role in Our Mission
You'll be joining our core engineering team to build a flagship mobile application from the ground up. As a Android Developer, you'll play a foundational role in shaping the Android experience through a fully native Jetpack Compose presentation layer, powered by Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) for shared business, networking, and data logic. How You’ll Make an Impact
Build & Innovate
•
Develop and maintain high-quality native Android applications using modern Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

Contribute to building a flagship mobile application from the ground up, helping shape its architecture and technical direction.

Build flexible, responsive layouts that adapt seamlessly across phones, foldables, and tablets.

•
Integrate and contribute to shared Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) modules for business logic, networking, and data management.
•
Work with third-party APIs, libraries, and services to deliver robust application functionality.
•
Collaborate with iOS/Swift engineers to ensure consistency and alignment across mobile platforms.
Performance & Engineering Excellence
•
Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and well-documented code, following principles such as KISS and Separation of Concerns.
•
Optimize Jetpack Compose performance by managing recompositions, implementing efficient Lazy lists, and improving application launch times.
•
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve performance and application stability issues.
•
Maintain high engineering standards through rigorous code reviews, constructive feedback, and quality-focused pull requests.
Product Collaboration
•
Partner with product managers and UX/UI designers to translate product requirements and designs into intuitive mobile experiences.
•
Participate in Agile development practices, contributing to planning, execution, and continuous improvement.
•
Stay curious about emerging technologies and contribute to the evolution of our mobile engineering practices.

What You Bring
•
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
•
4+ years of professional Android development experience, with a proven track record of shipping and maintaining production applications.
•
Strong practical knowledge of Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK, and Material Design 3 guidelines.
•
Experience with modern Android architecture patterns such as MVVM or MVI, with the ability to separate UI state from core business logic using Coroutines and Flows.
•
Experience consuming RESTful APIs and WebSockets, and working with asynchronous data flows using tools such as Ktor or Retrofit.
•
Hands-on experience building modern Android App Widgets using Glance or traditional RemoteViews.
•
Proficiency with Git and modern dependency management practices, including Gradle Kotlin DSL and Version Catalogs.
•
Strong coding skills, moderate algorithmic problem-solving ability, and a commitment to clean code principles and maintainable architecture.
•
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, participate in code reviews, and communicate technical decisions clearly.
•
A growth mindset and willingness to explore and learn parts of the Apple ecosystem when required.

Your X-Factor
•
Hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP/KMM) or previous experience developing native iOS applications.
•
Experience building custom graphics and charts using Compose Canvas, including K-line charts, curves, and pie/bar charts.
•
Familiarity with AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, with the engineering rigor to test, audit, and take ownership of AI-generated code.
•
A product-first mindset and the ability to build intuitive, performant, and user-focused mobile experiences.

30 minute HR interview with the Talent Acquisition team member

60-minute Bar Raiser Interview

Apply now and be part of our journey — the future is calling, and it starts with you.

The Role: Senior Associate, Fraud Operations

As a Senior Fraud Operations Associate in the Fraud domain, you will work to enhance and expand the features of our fraud detection and mitigation systems across various product lines, including Exchange, Credit Card, Equities, Predictions, Wallet, and across the entire customer lifecycle. You will be responsible for investigating customer accounts for first, second, and third party fraud, including payment instrument abuse, scams, and account takeovers. You will also be instrumental in shaping Gemini’s fraud models and rules, working regularly with product, engineering, and data science, as well as improving and optimizing operations itself to ensure a balance between customer friction and fraud.

Responsibilities:

• Investigate financial fraud and scams across multiple product lines

• Review complex data sets, such as ACH/debit card/credit card/wallet transactions, device telemetry, and blockchain data

• Respond to customers to obtain additional information regarding the actions that occurred on their account to make a properly informed decision

• Identify trends and patterns in fraud activity and suggest rule, feature, and policy updates

• Deeply understand the customer journeys to identify pain points due to fraud controls and suggest updates to alleviate them

• Leverage experience and knowledge to suggest improvements to operational flows

• Prepare fraud reports on material investigations and general fraudulent activity and present to leadership at weekly meetings

• This role may require an on-call or extended hours during fraud events

Minimum Qualifications:

• BA/BS in finance, economics, accounting, or related fields, or equivalent experience in said field

• 3-5+ years of direct fraud investigative experience, including in ACH and credit card fraud

• 2-5+ years of direct scam and account integrity investigative experience

• Knowledge of device telemetry data, account integrity systems, and internet technologies, such as VPNs

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Comfortable with making decisions in high ambiguity environments

• A healthy balance of empathy and skepticism, and the ability to acknowledge incorrect decisions

Preferred Qualifications:

• Regional fraud knowledge, including in the US and Singapore

• Experience with IDV, KYC, and transaction monitoring systems

It Pays to Work Here

The compensation & benefits package for this role includes:

• Competitive starting pay

• A discretionary annual bonus

• Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant

• Comprehensive health plans

• 401K with company matching

• Paid Parental Leave

• Flexible time off

Hourly Range: The hourly range for this role is between $43.50 - $58.00 in the State of New York. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. We’re looking for a commercially sharp Senior Manager, Payment Partnerships to join GTXN - a Luno company and own the sourcing, negotiation and delivery of new banking and payment-provider partnerships across Africa and Southeast Asia. You will be responsible for identifying, engaging and closing arrangements with the payment providers and banks that let GTXN move money for our customers reliably, quickly and at the right cost. This is a remote-first role, and you will report to Paul Harker.

You will bring hands-on experience building payment-provider and banking relationships in African markets, and be comfortable owning a deal from first conversation through contracting and go-live. Experience doing the same in Southeast Asia is a strong advantage.

Your mission will be:

• Identify, prioritise and build a pipeline of payment providers, banks and PSPs across African markets (and select Southeast Asian markets) that can extend GTXN’s ability to move money for Luno’s customers.

• Own end-to-end deal execution: outreach, commercial negotiation, contracting and onboarding of new banking and payment-provider partners.

• Manage and grow a portfolio of existing partner relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for commercial, operational and performance matters.

• Negotiate commercial terms — pricing, settlement, liability, SLAs — that improve the cost, coverage and reliability of GTXN’s payment rails.

• Work closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk and Product/Engineering to ensure new partnerships meet regulatory, licensing and integration requirements before go-live.

• Monitor partner performance against agreed SLAs (uptime, settlement times, success rates) and drive remediation where partners underperform.

• Track regulatory, competitive and market developments across target emerging markets that could affect partner selection or deal terms.

• Represent GTXN with key partners and at industry events, building GTXN’s reputation as a partner of choice in target markets.

• Feed market intelligence into GTXN’s regional expansion strategy, helping prioritise markets and partners with the strongest commercial and strategic fit.

A little about you:

• 5-8+ years of experience in payment partnerships, business development or commercial roles at a payment service provider, bank, remittance company or fintech, with a track record of sourcing and closing deals with banks and payment providers.

• Demonstrable experience engaging with payment providers and banks across African markets; experience doing the same in Southeast Asia is a strong advantage.

• Deep understanding of cross-border payment flows and the commercial and technical mechanics of PSP and banking partnerships (settlement, FX, licensing, compliance).

• Proven ability to independently source, negotiate and close commercial agreements, from first contact through contract execution and onboarding.

• Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills, able to structure deals that balance cost, risk and speed to market.

• Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a remote-first, distributed team, across multiple time zones and jurisdictions.

• Excellent relationship-management and stakeholder-management skills, able to work cross-functionally with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Product and Engineering.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages relevant to target African (or Southeast Asian) markets are advantageous.

• An existing network of relationships with payment providers and banks in target African markets is a strong advantage.

• Willingness to travel as required to meet partners and represent GTXN in-market.

• Working knowledge of, and genuine interest in, crypto and digital assets is advantageous, given GTXN's role within the broader Luno business.

First 6 Months:

• Build a prioritised pipeline of target payment-provider and banking partners across GTXN’s core African markets.

• Develop a strong working knowledge of GTXN’s existing partner network, product and commercial model.

• Close and onboard the first new partner agreement(s) in a priority market.

• Establish effective working relationships with Compliance, Legal, Risk and Product/Engineering to streamline partner onboarding.

• Build credibility as a trusted point of contact for both new and existing partners.

• Plus the option to buy and sell up to 5 days leave

• Improve body and mind, with excellent private medical insurance

• Retirement fund benefit helping you build the financial foundation you need to enjoy your future to the fullest.

• Access to Learnably and our additional learning platforms for your personal and professional development

• Annual Inspiration Day in addition to your annual leave which increases based on your length of service!

• Free lunch and snacks

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

The Strategic Markets and Global Marketing teams are responsible for accelerating sustainable growth across OKX’s priority markets. We work across regions and functions to identify opportunities, develop market strategies, strengthen execution, and build repeatable operating models that can scale globally.

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to serve as a trusted strategic and operational partner to the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, market expansion, business performance, and organizational execution.

You will translate strategic priorities into clear operating plans, drive high-priority cross-functional initiatives, improve decision-making through rigorous analysis, and ensure alignment across regional and global teams. You will also act as a connective layer between the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing leadership teams and key partners across Product, Marketing, Business Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and other functions.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial judgment, analytical rigor, executive presence, and hands-on execution. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, and taking ownership of complex initiatives from initial problem definition through to measurable results.

What You’ll Be Doing

Strategic Planning and Execution

•

Partner directly with the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing to define priorities, develop strategic plans, and translate objectives into clear initiatives, milestones, and areas of accountability.

•

Drive the annual and quarterly planning processes for Strategic Markets and Global Marketing, ensuring alignment between regional priorities and broader company objectives.

•

Lead complex, high-priority initiatives spanning multiple markets, business units, and functional teams.

•

Identify execution risks, dependencies, and organizational gaps early, and work with stakeholders to resolve them.

•

Ensure key decisions are translated into action, with clear ownership, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

Market Growth and Business Performance

•

Develop data-driven analyses and recommendations regarding market expansion, investment allocation, customer growth, partnerships, and other strategic opportunities.

•

Monitor market performance, commercial trends, competitive developments, and emerging risks across priority markets.

•

Partner with regional leaders to assess performance, identify growth opportunities, and strengthen local market strategies.

•

Build business cases and scenario analyses to support resource allocation and investment decisions.

•

Help develop repeatable market-entry and growth playbooks that can be applied across regions while accounting for local market conditions.

Operating Cadence and Governance

•

Establish and continuously improve the operating cadence for Strategic Markets and Global Marketing, including leadership meetings, business reviews, planning sessions, and regional performance reviews.

•

Develop dashboards and management reports that provide leadership with a clear view of performance, priorities, risks, and required decisions.

•

Create effective governance mechanisms for cross-functional initiatives, ensuring appropriate escalation and timely decision-making.

•

Maintain disciplined follow-through on leadership decisions, commitments, and strategic initiatives.

•

Improve the quality and flow of information among regional teams, functional partners, and senior leadership.

Executive Advisory and Decision Support

•

Serve as a trusted thought partner to the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing on strategic, commercial, operational, and organizational matters.

•

Synthesize complex information into clear insights, recommendations, executive briefings, and materials that support decision-making.

•

Prepare presentations, business reviews, strategic updates, and other materials for senior leadership.

•

Represent the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing leadership teams in selected meetings and initiatives, ensuring continuity, alignment, and follow-through.

Cross-Functional Leadership

•

Build strong relationships with regional leaders and global stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Business Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, HR, and Communications.

•

Act as a connector across teams, clarifying objectives, resolving competing priorities, and removing barriers to execution.

•

Lead special projects and time-sensitive initiatives that do not have a natural owner elsewhere in the organization.

•

Support organizational planning, resource prioritization, and ways of working as the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing function evolves.

•

Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and high performance.

What We Look For In You

•

Experience in strategy, business operations, management consulting, investment banking, technology, fintech, financial services, or a similarly fast-paced and analytical environment.

•

Demonstrated experience partnering directly with senior executives and influencing leaders across multiple functions and markets.

•

A strong track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution.

•

Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect market insights, customer needs, business performance, and company priorities.

•

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience developing business cases, performance analyses, and executive-level recommendations.

•

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex topics into clear decisions and action plans.

•

Strong executive presence and the ability to build trust with stakeholders across different functions, cultures, and levels of seniority.

•

High ownership, sound judgment, and a willingness to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels.

•

Ability to thrive in ambiguity, adapt quickly, and maintain momentum in a rapidly changing environment.

•

High integrity and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information.

•

Professional fluency in English.

Nice to Haves

•

Experience in crypto, fintech, digital assets, payments, or another highly regulated and rapidly evolving industry.

•

Experience supporting international expansion or managing initiatives across multiple geographic markets.

•

Prior experience as a Chief of Staff, strategy leader, business operations leader, or regional operator.

•

Familiarity with go-to-market strategy, growth planning, partnerships, and regional operating models.

•

Additional language capabilities relevant to OKX’s international markets.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

At Coinbase, our mission is to increase economic freedom around the world, and we couldn’t do this without hiring the best people. We’re a group of hard-working overachievers who are deeply focused on building the future of finance and Web3 for our users across the globe, whether they’re trading, storing, staking or using crypto. Know those people who always lead the group project? That’s us.

There are a few things we look for across all hires we make at Coinbase, regardless of role or team. First, we look for candidates who will thrive in a culture like ours, where we default to trust, embrace feedback, and disrupt ourselves. Second, we expect all employees to commit to our mission-focused approach to our work. Finally, we seek people who are excited to learn about and live crypto, because those are the folks who enjoy the intense moments in our sprint and recharge work culture. We’re a remote-first company looking to hire the absolute best talent all over the world.

Ready to #LiveCrypto? Who you are:

• You’ve got positive energy. You’re optimistic about the future and determined to get there.

• You’re never tired of learning. You want to be a pro in bleeding edge tech like DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, and Web 3.0.

• You appreciate direct communication. You’re both an active communicator and an eager listener - because let’s face it, you can’t have one without the other. You’re cool with candid feedback and see every setback as an opportunity to grow.

• You can pivot on the fly. Crypto is constantly evolving, so our priorities do, too. What you worked on last month may not be what you work on today, and that excites you. You’re not looking for a boring job.

• You have a “can do” attitude. Our teams create high-quality work on quick timelines. Owning a problem doesn’t scare you, but rather empowers you to take 100% responsibility for achieving our mission.

• You want to be part of a winning team. We’re stronger together, and you’re a person who embraces being pushed out of your comfort zone.

As a Customer Success Associate you will serve as a primary subject matter expert for Coinbase’s products, providing world-class service and support to our most valued customers. You’ll join a team of customer focused support professionals who know their performance is essential to Coinbase achieving its mission. We’re looking for an individual who has a passion for making the customer experience seamless and phenomenal.

What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties):

• Promote customer retention, growth and satisfaction by maintaining positive and long-term customer relationships, including proactively reaching out to customers based on user data, following-up on communications or providing additional education for our highest value customers.

• You will be responsible for providing best in class customer support, handling customers proactively to mitigate issues, handling contacts through to resolution, and collaborating across teams of subject matter specialists to fix issues with urgency.

• Model an investigative mentality: utilize data and customer feedback to help address critical customer issues at the root cause and eliminate defects in the customer experience.

• Proactively identify customer needs before they become an issue to simplify the customer experience, reduce friction, and strengthen trust in Coinbase.

• Champion clear communication with internal and external partners to align on solutions and drive results.

• Develop a deep understanding of Coinbase products and ongoing changes in the macro crypto environment so you can guide customers to navigate the quickly moving and ever changing crypto world and unlock additional features, services, and products that benefit their unique profile.

What we look for in you (ie. job requirements):

• Willingness to work nights and weekends to support the 24/7 nature of cryptocurrency markets.

• Motivated by Coinbase’s mission and creating a seamless experience for our highest value customers.

• Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in a customer service or support role in a fast paced environment including working with high value customers.

• Basic knowledge of blockchain, web3, staking, ROI/staking rewards, self-custody, and/or crypto.

• Flexible and adaptable to meet the evolving needs of a high-growth and fast paced organization.

• Fantastic communication and relationship management skills, passion for assisting customers to use Coinbase products successfully, and an eagerness to create a community of high value Coinbase power users.

Nice to haves:

• High level of proficiency in cryptocurrency and Coinbase products

• Previous experience in tech, crypto, finance, or fintech.

Finance Analytics builds Coinbase's financial data and reporting foundations so Finance, Accounting/Controllership, Treasury and FP&A can run accurate, timely and auditable operations. We sit at the intersection of data engineering, data science and business analytics: we own the source-of-truth financial datasets in Snowflake/Databricks, the pipelines that produce them, and the reconciliation, month-end close, safeguarding and reporting workflows built on top. We partner closely with Product Engineering to make sure upstream financial data is complete, reconciled and traceable.

What you'll be doing:

As the Staff Analytics Engineer on Finance Analytics, this person sets the technical direction for Coinbase's financial data layer and works side by side with Accounting, Controllership and FP&A. They need to understand how the books are closed, audited and controlled, not just how the data moves:

• Design and own the architecture of curated, well-documented source-of-truth financial datasets in Snowflake/Databricks that are correct, consistent and tie out to the general ledger.

• Build and own scalable batch (and where needed, near-real-time) pipelines orchestrated with Airflow/dbt, including dependency management, backfills and runbooks.

• Define reusable data quality and reconciliation frameworks (tests, monitoring, alerting, SLAs) and agree with Accounting on what "done" means for financial correctness.

• Drive data contracts with upstream engineering teams, mentor Analytics Engineers, and build abstractions (Python packages, UDFs, LLM-assisted tools) that make finance data users more efficient.

• Accounting exposure, either formal (accounting/finance degree or coursework, CPA/CMA) or hands-on work with Accounting/FP&A teams, such as supporting month-end close, reconciliations or financial reporting.

APAC is growing hard, across four very different markets, and product now sits within the region, reporting to the Managing Director, APAC. This is the seat that owns what gets built across the region and whether clients love it.

This is a senior seat with real ownership: product and design for an entire region, a large multi-market team to lead and build, an aggressive growth agenda to ship against, and a direct line to the Managing Director, APAC. Own the North Star and the product metrics that matter, and track performance after every launch.

BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE


Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

We are hiring several Senior Compliance Associates to carry out day to day surveillance across our markets, investigate what that surveillance uncovers, and help us build the programme out as the business grows.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Review and disposition surveillance alerts across our regulated markets, and record the reasoning behind each decision clearly enough that someone else can follow it.

 - Carry out analytical reviews that begin with trade and order data rather than with a system-generated alert.

 - Investigate escalated behaviour end to end: gather the data, reconstruct what happened, and write it up for presentation to senior compliance stakeholders.

 - Assess referrals raised from across the business and externally, and take forward the ones that warrant it.

 - Draft suspicious transaction and order reports and suspicious activity reports.

 - Produce management information and regulatory reporting for the entities we cover.

 - Contribute to surveillance platform and tooling work, including bringing new products and data sources into scope and testing that detection behaves as intended.

 - Use AI and automation tools to speed up evidence-gathering and case reconstruction, with human judgement over the final call. 

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - At least 2 years experience in trade surveillance, market abuse investigation or trading conduct inside a regulated firm, such as an exchange, broker-dealer, trading venue, bank or comparable regulated trading business.

 - Working knowledge of the core market abuse typologies, for example spoofing, layering, wash trading, insider dealing, front running and ramping.

 - Experience reviewing and dispositioning surveillance alerts, and writing up what you found to a standard others can rely on.

 - Clear, evidence-first written communication. Your case files and escalations will sometimes be read by auditors and regulators without you in the room to explain them.

About the Opportunity

Lead infrastructure architecture and core platform development for the AI Native era, covering CI/CD, AIOps, observability, and monorepo engineering. Build platforms that support multiple programming languages across host-based and containerized environments.

Use platform engineering, intelligent tooling, and automated quality controls to enable developers and AI agents to work together, improving developer productivity, software quality, and production reliability.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Infrastructure Architecture and Evolution: Define platform architecture, technical standards, and roadmaps, balancing scalability, reliability, security, and cost. Lead critical component design, hands-on development, and implementation across teams.

•

AI Native Engineering Capabilities: Connect code, documentation, dependencies, test results, and runtime data into usable engineering context. Expose capabilities through APIs, CLIs, and SDKs for developers and agents to understand and review code, run tests, and resolve issues. Establish task evaluations, output validation, and execution permissions.

•

Infrastructure for Multiple Languages: Build extensible toolchains, dependency management, testing, and delivery capabilities for ecosystems such as Go, Java, Python, C++, and Rust. Use standard protocols and SDKs to support communication across languages, interface compatibility, and consistent telemetry, reducing platform integration effort.

•

Monorepo and Build Systems: Define repository structure, module boundaries, dependency policies, and code ownership to support changes across modules and independent service releases. Apply practices from systems such as Bazel and Buck2 to deliver incremental and reproducible builds, affected-test selection, remote caching, and remote execution.

•

CI/CD and Quality Engineering: Build shared platforms for builds, tests, artifacts, and releases across hosts and containers. Improve configuration governance, automated quality gates, progressive delivery, health verification, and rollback to shorten delivery cycles and reduce change risk.

•

Observability and Reliability: Unify metrics, logs, traces, and profiling, linking telemetry to code, configuration, dependencies, and deployments. Establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and alerting practices, and feed production findings back into engineering quality improvements.

•

AIOps and Automated Remediation: Combine telemetry, topology, change history, and operational knowledge to enable anomaly detection, incident investigation, root cause analysis, and controlled remediation. Use incident replay, evaluation, and feedback to reduce recovery time and repetitive operational work.

What We Look For In You

•

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. At least 8 years of infrastructure or platform engineering experience, including 3 years in architecture or technical leadership.

•

Deep expertise in at least one of CI/CD, build systems, observability, or AIOps, with experience designing, implementing, and operating large production systems.

•

Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, distributed systems, and troubleshooting. Experience with deployment, configuration management, resource isolation, and production diagnostics in host-based and Kubernetes environments.

•

Experience building infrastructure for multiple languages, with an understanding of toolchain, dependency, and runtime differences. Ability to design shared platform interfaces and extensible language integrations.

•

Familiarity with open-source infrastructure practices originating at Google or Meta, such as build and dependency management with Bazel or Buck2, or cross-language communication and interface contracts with gRPC and Protocol Buffers. Experience evaluating, integrating, or optimizing relevant technologies.

•

Experience with automated testing, quality gates, and release engineering, using observability and reliability measures to improve delivery workflows.

•

Practical experience applying LLMs or agents to engineering workflows, including context construction, tool use, task orchestration, evaluation, and safe execution.

• Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, Java, C++, or Rust, with strong hands-on coding and debugging skills. Ability to drive implementation through design reviews, technical guidance, and collaboration across teams.

Nice to Haves

•

Experience at Google, Meta, or other leading technology companies, and a background in infrastructure, developer productivity, or AI Native engineering platforms, are preferred.

•

Leading large monorepos, build platforms supporting multiple languages, remote execution platforms, or enterprise developer productivity platforms.

•

Building AI-powered code review, test generation, incident diagnosis, or automated remediation systems and validating them in production.

•

Operating large environments spanning hosts and containers, improving software supply chain security, or contributing to relevant open-source projects.

Competitive total compensation package

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

Wellness and meal allowances

About etoro:

etoro is the platform where you can trade, invest, save, and spend. Founded in 2007 with the vision of a world where everyone can trade and invest in a simple and transparent way, we've built a regulated, Nasdaq-listed platform used by millions of people in 75 countries.

We believe there is power in shared knowledge. By combining the collective intelligence of our community with AI-powered tools, we've created a collaborative investment community designed to help you grow your knowledge and wealth.

On etoro, you can hold a range of traditional and innovative assets and choose how you invest: trade directly, invest in a portfolio, copy other investors, or invest with an AI agent. Visit our Media Centre for the latest news.

You can find out more about eToro here.

eToro | Global Markets & 24/7 Operations

Financial markets never stop moving, and neither do the systems that power trading at eToro. Our Trading Systems team sits at the center of live market activity, supporting trading across global markets, multiple asset classes, execution venues, and both traditional finance (TradFi) and decentralized finance (DeFi) workflows.

We are looking for a Trading System Specialist to join our 24/7 operations team. This is a hands-on role combining trading, markets, technology, AI, and real-time operations. You will follow market conditions and risk, support and execute trading activity within defined procedures, investigate incidents, and help keep our trading operation running smoothly around the clock.

AI is central to how we want the team to work. We are looking for someone who is curious, agile, and comfortable using AI agents, skills, automation, and AI-assisted development to solve problems and build better workflows. You do not need to be a programmer or an experienced trader, but you should be eager to learn markets and technology quickly and turn ideas into practical solutions.

What You'll Do

• Monitor and manage real-time trading and production systems across global financial markets, including stocks, FX, commodities, futures, and cryptocurrencies.

• Monitor market conditions, pricing, liquidity, trading activity, positions, and risk exposures.

• Execute manual trades, adjust hedging parameters within defined bounds, and support trading operations across multiple asset classes and execution venues.

• Monitor and support TradFi and DeFi trading workflows, including execution, liquidity, hedging, transaction flows, and settlement across relevant venues and systems.

• Make operational adjustments to trading configurations in accordance with established procedures and risk limits.

• Investigate trading failures, system alerts, and operational incidents, assess their impact, escalate when necessary, and follow incidents through to resolution.

• Maintain operational discipline during live shifts, ensure timely follow-up on outstanding issues, and provide clear handovers to the next shift.

• Use AI tools, agents, and automation to investigate problems, analyze data, develop solutions, and improve daily operations.

• Build and enhance internal tools, dashboards, integrations, and workflows using AI-assisted development and automation platforms.

• Work closely with global teams, including Trading, Risk, Technology, Product, and Operations.

• Identify opportunities to improve monitoring, operational efficiency, and system reliability.

• Support the continuous expansion of our 24/7 production monitoring capabilities.

Please note: this is a 24/7 shift position that includes nights, weekends, and holidays

Requirements

• AI-first mindset: Genuine enthusiasm for AI and a practical understanding of how to use modern AI tools beyond basic chat, including AI agents, skills, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development.

• Interest in financial markets: Strong curiosity about capital markets, trading, and financial instruments, from traditional markets to crypto and DeFi. Eagerness to understand how global markets operate and develop practical trading knowledge.

• Technical curiosity and resourcefulness: Comfortable exploring new technologies, working with data and systems, and finding creative ways to solve unfamiliar challenges. A software development background is not required.

• Agility and fast learning: Ability to quickly adapt, independently learn new tools and concepts, and apply them to real-world challenges.

• Strong problem-solving skills: Analytical thinking, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to investigate issues independently while recognizing when to escalate.

• Ownership and accountability: A proactive approach, willingness to take responsibility for assigned actions, follow issues through to resolution, and maintain high standards in a live operational environment.

• Teamwork and communication: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and cross-functional teams around the world.

• Excellent English: Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• 24/7 shift availability: Willingness to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

• Data and spreadsheet fluency: Comfortable using Excel or similar tools to investigate, validate, and communicate data in day-to-day operations.

• Operational organization and attention to detail: Able to prioritize multiple live issues, keep accurate records, and provide clear, actionable handovers.

Nice to Have

• Trading experience: Professional trading experience, experience in a dealing room or financial institution, or active personal trading in financial markets.

• Hands-on experience with AI-powered development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or similar platforms.

• Experience creating AI agents, custom skills, automated workflows, or integrations between applications and services.

• Familiarity with APIs, SQL, Python, scripting, or data analysis tools.

• Financial data, BI, or production monitoring exposure: Experience working with raw market or trading data, BI tools, dashboards, monitoring/observability platforms, real-time production systems, or incident management.

• Relevant education or practical background: Finance, economics, computer science, information systems, or another relevant field. A specific degree is not required.

• Knowledge of financial instruments, trading platforms, pricing, liquidity, hedging, or risk management.

• TradFi, crypto, or DeFi exposure: Familiarity with centralized trading venues, crypto markets, decentralized protocols, on-chain transactions, wallets, or settlement processes.

Our Hiring Philosophy:

At etoro, AI is changing how we build, work and make decisions, and our hiring approach reflects that. We are building an AI-first organisation where people are encouraged to use AI thoughtfully.

That starts with how we hire. Throughout our recruitment process, we may use AI-enabled tools, including interview notetakers and other technologies that help us capture information accurately, improve consistency and create a better experience for candidates and interviewers. These tools support our feedback and assessment outcomes. Hiring decisions remain grounded in running fair and consistent interview processes, human judgement, critical thinking, and thorough evaluation of experience, ability and motivation that are aligned to our business and role requirements.

We also want candidates to be comfortable working with AI. Depending on the role, we may explore how you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, how you think about their opportunities and limitations, and how you would contribute to etoro’s continued AI build-out.

For us, being AI-first is not about replacing human judgement. It is about combining human expertise, creativity and accountability with technology that helps us do our best work and accelerate our growth. In the end, that's what we're hiring for: human insight, supercharged by AI.

• Strong understanding of exchange liquidity economics and risk frameworks, including funding rates, index/mark price methodology, price limits, tick sizes, leverage/position tiers, and fee strategy.

• Experience delivering regulatory-sensitive launches and partnering closely with compliance/legal teams; familiarity with Singapore, EU (MiCA) and other major jurisdictions is preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to work directly with institutional clients, market makers and vendor partners; strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Technical fluency in exchange systems and blockchain technology; familiarity with smart contracts and token economics is a plus.•

• Competitive total compensation package

• L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

• Various team building programs and company event

• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

Work closely with regional business leaders, marketing, product, legal and compliance teams to identify and execute communications opportunities aligned with business priorities.

Leverage and expand relationships with journalists, editors and influential industry voices across APAC, particularly in Australia and Singapore, as well as global tier-one media covering the region.

Proactively identify, pitch and secure compelling stories in leading business, financial, broadcast, technology and crypto publications, driving consistent, high-quality media coverage.

Support regional executives with media interviews, speaking opportunities and thought leadership activities.

Manage PR agency relationships and coordinate external partners to deliver against agreed objectives.

Support issues management and crisis communications, working closely with regional stakeholders and the global communications team.

Monitor media coverage, track PR performance and report on results, with a focus on coverage quality, reputation and business impact.

Demonstrated success securing high-quality coverage in leading international and regional publications and delivering impactful PR campaigns.

Our team describes us as a place for the curious and the driven, and we like to do things a little differently; as a transformative global fintech we’re digital, nimble, connected and united in our vision to create a better way to trade.
We thrive on progress – for our clients and for ourselves. Our organisational culture is ever-evolving, vibrant, diverse, global and results focused.
You’ll find our 700+ team currently across 12 locations and 9 time zones.

The Role
The Senior Manager, Business Operations - Product will partner with the GM, Product to turn Product strategy into execution, keeping the function connected, transparent and outcome-focused.
You’ll maintain a clear view across priorities, roadmaps, delivery, resources and performance, flagging risks and dependencies early. You’ll translate strategy into measurable goals and executable plans, keep roadmaps, Jira and delivery aligned across Product and Engineering, and remove blockers independently.
You’ll also provide leadership with a reliable view of product, client, commercial and delivery metrics, and drive cross-product initiatives spanning multiple domains and functions.
This is a senior, highly autonomous role for someone who combines strategic thinking with operational discipline and sound judgement, and who turns ambiguity into clear recommendations and action.
Your key responsibilities will include:
• Act as a trusted operational partner to the GM, Product, translating Product strategy into measurable goals, porfolio priorities, roadmaps and executable plans, and surfacing issues requiring GM attention with clear context and recommendations
• Maintain a consolidated view of Product priorities and investment across domains, ensuring strategic priorities are reflected in where Product and Technology effort is focused
• Lead the portfolio prioritisation and quarterly planning, bringing together client impact, commercial value, strategic importance, dependencies, delivery complexity and available capacity

Job TitleThird Party Risk Management (TPRM) Co-ordinator

Job Description
So, who are we?

IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.

The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.

Join us at IG – the future gets built here.

Your Team

The TPRM team keeps our vendor ecosystem safe, compliant, and running smoothly — and that only happens because someone is on top of the details, every day. As TPRM Co-ordinator, you are that someone. You'll keep the vendor ongoing monitoring lifecycle moving: chasing documents, updating registers, coordinating reviews, and making sure nothing slips through the cracks. Keep continuous focus and monitoring on high risk and outsourcing relationships.

Your role in the Team’s Success

Our tools and dashboards do the tracking — they don't do the judgment. Knowing which overdue item is actually urgent, which vendor query needs escalating rather than answering, and which register inconsistency signals a real problem rather than a typo is a human read on the situation, built up through relationships and pattern recognition. That's what this role is for.

What you'll do

• Ensure Ongoing Monitoring and Assurance.
• Keep the data repositories/systems accurate and up to date, flagging gaps or inconsistencies before they become problems.
• Schedule and coordinate vendor and stakeholder review meetings; capture notes, actions, and follow-ups through to closure.
• Support ongoing vendor monitoring by tracking SLA/KPI submissions, chasing overdue items, etc.
• Help maintain the critical supplier and outsourcing register — data entry, validation, and periodic reconciliation.
• Act as first point of contact for routine stakeholder queries, resolving what you can and routing anything judgment-heavy to the right person, without letting it stall.
• Support audit and assurance activity by pulling together evidence packs and coordinating responses across stakeholder groups.
• Assist with Power BI dashboard data refreshes and produce routine reports under guidance from the TPRM Lead.
• Maintain version control and document housekeeping for the SRM Management policy and framework library.
• Coordinate system and SharePoint access requests for the TPRM tool and related platforms.
• Help keep TPRM communications and SharePoint content current, working from templates and direction set by the Senior Vendor Management Specialist.
• Contribute to external best-practice and market benchmarking research when asked.

• 3–5 years of experience in vendor/supplier management, procurement coordination, contract administration, or third-party risk support.

Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.

Join us for this exciting journey.

Apply now!

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - LLM traffic doesn't behave like normal API traffic. Requests are long-running, streaming and expensive. One prompt can cost a few cents or a few dollars. One team's burst can burn another team's budget. Providers change their rate limits, failure modes and pricing without warning. Running this well is a problem few companies have solved, and it's the job.
   
   - Own the reliability of the platform engineers depend on: the AI Gateway, the agent runtime and the connections to internal tools. Set the SLOs, own the error budgets and decide what happens when they're spent.
   
   - Design resilience across model providers: routing, failover, retries, rate limiting and graceful degradation when a provider is slow, throttling or down.
   
   - Make LLM traffic legible. Build observability that shows latency, errors, token usage and cost by team, model and use case, so engineers can see what their workloads cost and where they're spending their time waiting.
   
   - Treat capacity and cost as one problem. Routing decisions affect both latency and spend, and you'll own the tradeoff directly.
   
   - Work with Security, Finance and AI governance to put access controls, budgets, audit logging and data handling into the platform, not into a spreadsheet next to it.
   
   - Lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews. Turn what breaks into fixes that stay fixed.
   
   - Automate operations with infrastructure as code, safe deployments and progressive rollouts, so the platform gets more reliable as it grows rather than more fragile.
   
   - Mentor engineers and raise the operating standard across the team.
   
   This is a Staff role. You'll set the technical direction for how the platform runs, not just keep it running. The platform is small enough that your decisions shape it directly, and used broadly enough that they affect every engineering team at Kraken.
   
   


SKILLS YOU SHOULD HODL

 - Extensive experience in site reliability, infrastructure or platform engineering, with a track record of owning high-traffic, business-critical services in production

 - Proficiency in Rust or Python, and comfort reading and changing a production service's code

 - Experience with API gateways, reverse proxies or traffic management: load balancing, rate limiting, failover and caching

 - Experience operating multi-tenant internal platforms, including authentication, authorization and per-tenant cost controls

 - Staff-level influence: you set direction across teams, write clear design documents and bring other engineers with you

 - Experience operating LLM gateways or integrating LLM provider APIs at scale: streaming, token-based rate limiting, model routing and caching
